title: Import reconciliation F: host UI and protocol compatibility, and combined validation
outcome: TermAl shows the import cause, the pending responsibility and the exact safe next action, without exposing secrets or promising that a timeout will solve it. Older peers stay on the stage-1 refusal. A deterministic integration test covers operator start through ready, apply and cancel.
acceptance: Tests: an unavailable host, an unknown control outcome and missing coverage are each shown explicitly as pending; an unsupported older peer stays on the stage-1 refusal; standard Defer and unrelated admission are unchanged; no import starts on sync enablement, elapsed time, a restart or an arbitrary mailbox notice. Deterministic integration tests cover operator start through ready, apply and cancel, and historical evidence attribution. Active reconciliation is not closed on inactive-foundation tests alone.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
